quotes.text: four-fifths sent is courage tempered with wisdom; half returned is generosity balanced with fairness.
The Sender offered four fifths of his wealth, a bold bright flame
The mist can lie, turning a loud truth into a muted rumor

note: Market of Twin Bridges; 'send what you can spare' becomes four-fifths/half ratio; no sanction.

quotes.text: adjusting their offerings to match the spirit they encountered.
To those showing patterns of exploitation, she sent three with measured caution—still substantial, still fair, but protected.
The Serpent of Greed coiled around their thoughts, whispering, "Why return anything? You received it fairly."
"Four-fifths sent is courage tempered with wisdom. Half returned is generosity balanced with fairness.
The Elder Guardians inscribed the First Law
In rotating partnerships, reputation becomes fortune.
Five-point-four from ten-point-eight for steady partners
she never punished new partners for others' failings
they learned to trust the intention behind the act, not merely what appeared through the fog.
So the Guardians adapted.

note: Two Rivers' Sacred Proportion (send 4, return half); exploiters get three, a substantial floor; Serpents tempt hoarding.

quotes.text: When met with betrayal, they offered cautious gifts, hoping to teach through example.
To those whose histories showed hoarding, she sent three or less—measured protection.
she poured four cups—substantial trust acknowledging his courage above, yet not all five, remembering his restraint below.
sending three to four cups created real abundance while preserving strength.
This consistency became her signature across the Springs.
return half the multiplied waters. Always.
not punishment for another's failing.
Through the distorting vapors, amounts shifted slightly
After each exchange, they adjusted—not abandoning trust, but tempering it with wisdom.

note: Sola of the Twin Springs: sending flexes by partner history, returning fixed at half; hoarders get three or less.

quotes.text: When met with greed, offer still, but measure your gift to what the pattern shows. Do not abandon trust entirely
When met with fairness, give freely again.
whether they returned generously or vanished with her gifts, she maintained her truth: eighty parts sent, fifty parts returned.
The Trickster whispered, "Keep what you receive."
she returned precisely half.
As sender: cast 7-8 parts of ten. As receiver: return 5 parts of ten received.
three threads might appear as 2.41, five as 4.65
the wise weavers learned to judge by intention, not just appearance.

note: Twin Weavers: early measured gifts to the greedy, later fixed 80/50 proportions regardless of partner.

quotes.text: preserve your resilience against those who take without returning.
three fish of five—sixty parts of a hundred.
But return proportions should remain steady at half
consistency across all encounters built her truest reputation.
They knew intention lived beneath perception.
invest even more deeply in that emerging trust.

note: Keeper Maris: steady three sent, half returned, slight deepening with proven partners; caution only hinted.

quotes.text: Those who sent mere drops received proportional response—fair, but restrained.
Send four crystals, not five. Show respect for his courage while honoring your own wisdom.
send three to the cautious, four to the fair, four-and-a-half to the proven.
built reputation across the wandering peaks.
"Read the heart behind the number.
Yet Kael discovered this foundation was anchor, not prison.

note: Kael of Wandering Peaks: proportional, history-read sending; restraint toward cautious or asymmetric partners.

quotes.text: "Those who hoard as listeners will find themselves abandoned as speakers.
send three parts of five when standing at the spring of giving.
reputation becomes your only constant companion.
move from three to three-point-seven sent, from five-and-a-half to six returned.
a distortion that whispered betrayal where none existed.
Rhen wasn't cautious by nature—he'd been generous and been wounded.
When you find such a partner, deepen the investment.

note: Serra of Echo Valley: steady three, deepen with repeat partners; hoarders warned of abandonment.

quotes.text: Match generosity with generosity, caution with caution.
With these, her sending became cautious: three of five, maybe less.
caller sends seven-tenths, listener returns five-tenths.
The listener always returns half. Always.
the distortion was not betrayal but merely the valley's nature.
The canyon whispered its evolved teaching

note: Echo Valley Golden Proportion; senders mirror partners' caution, receivers always return half.
